verdicts.reason: Both break the same way. 'Only this Christmas', the stars, the URL and the dashed rules all sit on the busy sweater and mug photo, so they are hard to read and collide with the image. 'GET A GIFT' is shrunk below the 'with your next cup of coffee' subhead, which flips the hierarchy. In A the tiny 'LYGOM CAFE' wordmark and its stacked brand cluster crowd the top-left, but the left column is at least ordered. B makes the subhead even bigger, so the hierarchy is worse. B also packs the logo, gifts and headline into one cramped row with 'GET A GIFT' pushed against the photo edge, and puts 'Only this Christmas' right over the mug.
